author: ganglyu
body:

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
```
 'PORT': {'fortyGigE0/124': {'admin_status': 'up',
                             'description': 'ARISTA04T1:Ethernet1/1',
                             'fec': 'rs',
                             'mtu': '9100',
                             'pfc_asym': 'off',
                             'speed': '100000',
                             'tpid': '0x8100'},
          'fortyGigE0/4': {'admin_status': 'up',
                           'autoneg': 'on',
                           'description': 'Servers0:eth0',
                           'fec': 'none',
                           'mtu': '9100',
                           'pfc_asym': 'off',
                           'speed': '100000',
                           'tpid': '0x8100'}},
 'PORTCHANNEL': {'PortChannel01': {'admin_status': 'up',
                                   'members': ['fortyGigE0/112'],
                                   'min_links': '1',
                                   'mtu': '9100',
                                   'tpid': '0x8100'},
                 'PortChannel02': {'admin_status': 'up',
                                   'members': ['fortyGigE0/116'],
                                   'min_links': '1',
                                   'mtu': '9100',
                                   'tpid': '0x8100'},
                 'PortChannel03': {'admin_status': 'up',
                                   'members': ['fortyGigE0/120'],
                                   'min_links': '1',
                                   'mtu': '9100',
                                   'tpid': '0x8100'},
                 'PortChannel04': {'admin_status': 'up',
                                   'members': ['fortyGigE0/124'],
                                   'min_links': '1',
                                   'mtu': '9100',
                                   'tpid': '0x8100'}},
 'PORTCHANNEL_INTERFACE': {'PortChannel01': {},
                           'PortChannel01|10.0.0.56/31': {},
                           'PortChannel01|FC00::71/126': {},
                           'PortChannel02': {},
                           'PortChannel02|10.0.0.58/31': {},
                           'PortChannel02|FC00::75/126': {},
                           'PortChannel03': {},
                           'PortChannel03|10.0.0.60/31': {},
                           'PortChannel03|FC00::79/126': {},
                           'PortChannel04': {},
                           'PortChannel04|10.0.0.62/31': {},
                           'PortChannel04|FC00::7D/126': {}},
 'PORTCHANNEL_MEMBER': {'PortChannel01|fortyGigE0/112': {'NULL': 'NULL'},
                        'PortChannel02|fortyGigE0/116': {'NULL': 'NULL'},
                        'PortChannel03|fortyGigE0/120': {'NULL': 'NULL'},
                        'PortChannel04|fortyGigE0/124': {'NULL': 'NULL'}},
```
Config db schema generated by minigraph can’t pass yang validation:

* port table does not have fortyGigE0/112, fortyGigE0/116, fortyGigE0/120.

It seems that we need to update yang model or sonic-config-engine.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run command 'sonic-cfggen -m tests/t0-sample-graph.xml --print-data'.
2. Use sonic_yang to validate config db schema.

#### Describe the results you received:
Yang validation failed.

#### Describe the results you expected:
Yang validation should pass.

https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-config-engine/minigraph.py#L484-L485
PortChannel must have 'AttachTo' field, and 'AttachTo' field must not be None.
So I can't delete the links on non-existing ports, unless I modify minigraph.py to remove the limitations.
